findings.description: Added verifyAdminToken check to POST /api/sources.
Added verifyAdminToken check to DELETE /api/sources/[id].
Added UUID validation for sessionId/guestId and max-length check on message (4000 chars).
Gemini API key check moved before Redis writes via module-level singleton; returns 500 early if key missing.
Added startup guard in lib/redis.ts; added REDIS_URL guard in lib/pubsub.ts createSubscriber.
SHA-256 password hash intentional per CLAUDE.md Hard Safety Rules. Skipped per project rule.
Added guestId ownership verification; frontend sends guestId in request body.
formatRelativeTime and formatDate extracted to lib/format.ts and imported in all consumers.
xlsxToCSV extracted to lib/xlsx-utils.ts.
getDeviceInfo extracted to lib/device-info.ts.
Dead NavBar component removed; sources redirect moved to middleware.
Shared createChannelSSE helper extracted to lib/sse.ts; both stream routes simplified.
ChatPage split into ChatSidebar, MessageList, ChatInput sub-components in app/chat/components/.
Gemini SDK moved to module-level singleton; saves per-request instantiation.
indexSource() upsert batches now run in parallel with Promise.all.
Added isRefetchingRef in-flight guard to fetchSessions; skips concurrent fetches.
toolbarBtnStyle, popoverItemStyle, navLinkStyle extracted to lib/ui-styles.ts; imported in ChatInput, admin session page, admin layout.
Removed redundant fetchSession() calls from sendMessage, takeOver, handBack — SSE delivers state.
setSessionMode(id, mode) helper extracted to lib/session-actions.ts; join and leave routes simplified.
Dead guestToSessions Map replaced with Set<string> of guestIds.
GET handler now uses Redis pipeline for batch mode fetches instead of Promise.all of individual GETs.
React keys changed from array index to stable `${msg.timestamp}-${msg.role}` composite in MessageList and admin session page.
Removed unused HistoryEntry interface from lib/types.ts.
Removed const loading = sessionLoading alias; sessionLoading used directly.
const isChat = pathname.startsWith('/chat') — always-true variable removed during ChatPage split (f-013).
Added console.error to SSE catch blocks in chat/page.tsx and admin session page.
Named constants VECTOR_CHUNK_SIZE, VECTOR_TOP_K, VECTOR_MIN_SCORE exported from lib/vector.ts.
Extracted useFetchStat<T>(url) generic hook; replaced loadSessionStats and loadSourceStats boilerplate.
Removed no-op redis.set(sessionModeKey(id), 'human') from message route — mode already set by join.
xlsx (SheetJS Community Edition ^0.18.5) has known security advisories and has been effectively abandoned since 2023. Consider replacing with exceljs or adding lockfile audit to CI.
Admin global sessions SSE stream duplicates createChannelSSE factory inline instead of calling lib/sse.ts; also ignores message payload and always sends 'data: update\n\n'.
Sources POST has a read-then-write race: sources list fetched before indexing and again after — concurrent uploads can see stale state.
Middleware matcher doesn't cover /api/sources* routes; POST/DELETE are auth-guarded within handlers but not at middleware level — verify intentional.
Unhandled Gemini API errors: chat.sendMessage() rejections propagate as unhandled promise rejections with no JSON body — wrap in try/catch as already done in summary/route.ts.
SSE abort handler: sub.unsubscribe().then(() => sub.disconnect()) has no .catch(); unsubscribe errors surface as unhandled rejections on Vercel.
SessionRow type is defined in constants.ts (a UI file) but is a data shape — belongs in lib/types.ts alongside SessionMeta, SessionMessage, LeadData.
useFetchStat fetches stats via GET /api/admin/sessions/clear, /leads/clear, /sources/clear — stats display is tightly coupled to destructive-action routes.
No Vercel region or function config — SSE routes share a TCP connection to a fixed Upstash Redis endpoint; pinning to one region reduces latency.
isChat/isProfile use exact pathname match — adding a new user-area route requires updating this component; use startsWith or a route config array.
No HTTP security headers configured — add X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, HSTS, and CSP via next.config.js headers().
User-supplied model string passed directly to Gemini's getGenerativeModel() without validating against MODELS allowlist in app/chat/constants.ts.
/api/session/[id]/end accepts POST from any caller — add guestId ownership check matching the pattern in request-human/route.ts.
/api/session/[id]/switch-ai accepts POST from any caller — add verifyAdminToken since switching a session back to AI is an admin operation.
GET /api/sources returns full list of source filenames, IDs, and chunk counts with no auth — add verifyAdminToken to GET handler.
UPSTASH_VECTOR_REST_URL and UPSTASH_VECTOR_REST_TOKEN use non-null assertion (!) with no startup guard — add explicit guard matching the pattern in lib/redis.ts.
Admin message text field not validated for presence, type, or length before being stored in Redis.
Sort query param used as a key into LeadData objects without allowlisting valid field names.
requestHuman and switchToAI are fire-and-forget — a failed fetch silently leaves session mode desynced from the server with no user feedback.
endChat is fire-and-forget — a network failure leaves the session open on the server while the UI does nothing.
Token presence (cookie exists) but not validity checked in middleware — stale/forged admin_token passes the gate; only caught inside individual API route handlers.
vercel.json has no security headers — paired with f-040: one of next.config.js or vercel.json must define them.
Logout route performs no auth check before clearing the cookie — harmless but inconsistent with the rest of the admin surface.
s.guestId.slice(0,8) appears in browser notification body — partial internal identifier exposed to OS notification center logs.
/admin/login bypass uses exact string match — /admin/login/ with trailing slash would still be blocked; use pathname.split('?')[0] === '/admin/login'.
COUNTRY_CODES, COUNTRIES, EDUCATION_LEVELS, MONTHS, validate(), and border helpers fully duplicated between LeadForm.tsx and app/(user-area)/profile/page.tsx — extract to a shared module.
SessionMeta type missing lastActiveAt field — set and read in at least 3 call-sites but defined ad-hoc in layout files rather than the canonical type.
CHUNK_SIZE is a redundant local alias for VECTOR_CHUNK_SIZE defined two lines above — remove and use VECTOR_CHUNK_SIZE directly.
SSE stream ignores message payload and always sends 'data: update\n\n' — fixed as part of refactoring to use createChannelSSE (f-031).
Admin message route hardcodes mode:'human' in publishSession call — if session is in 'requested' or 'ai' mode the published event incorrectly signals 'human'.
Hardcoded 'gemini-3.1-flash-lite' string literal — should reference DEFAULT_MODEL from app/chat/constants.ts to avoid drift.
Fallback model hardcoded as string literal instead of importing DEFAULT_MODEL from app/chat/constants.ts.
Upload response not checked for !resp.ok before resp.json() — a 400/500 silently calls resp.json() on an error body.
Remove response not checked for !resp.ok before resp.json() — same bug as the upload path.
fetchLeads missing try/finally to clear loading state — if the fetch throws, setLoading(false) is never called and the spinner hangs.
First useEffect omits fetchSession from its dependency array — fetchSession is a useCallback depending on [id, router]; stale closure risk if router identity changes.
No lint or type-check scripts — add 'lint': 'next lint' and 'type-check': 'tsc --noEmit'.
Catch clause `catch (e)` shadows the outer variable `e` in the SSE onmessage handler — rename to err or parseErr.
Mac OS X branch fires before iPhone/iPad branches — all iPhone/iPad UAs include 'like Mac OS X', making iOS/iPadOS branches unreachable; fix branch order.
Local formatDate uses en-MY locale — if intentional, rename to formatDateLocale; if not, consolidate into lib/format.ts with an optional locale param.
Local btnStyle constant duplicates toolbarBtnStyle from lib/ui-styles.ts — import and use the shared constant.
handleAccept and handleLogout fire-and-forget fetch calls with no error handling — a failed join or logout leaves the UI in inconsistent state.
alert() and confirm() used for duplicate detection and removal confirmation — blocks main thread, inaccessible; replace with inline state-driven confirmation UI.
Upload error has no user-visible feedback — only console.error is called; button silently resets to idle on failure.
Inline type annotation repeats all seven LeadData fields — use Pick<LeadData, ...> or LeadData directly to avoid duplication with lib/types.ts.
SpinnerIcon SVG defined inline in chat/page.tsx and duplicated in profile/page.tsx — extract to a shared Spinner component in app/chat/components/.
CURRENT_YEAR computed at module load time in both LeadForm.tsx and profile/page.tsx — move inside validate() or the shared data module to avoid year-boundary caching issue.
guestId param not validated against UUID_RE before use in Redis key — inconsistent with app/api/guest/[guestId]/lead/route.ts which validates.
id param not validated against UUID pattern before use in Redis key helpers — add UUID guard consistent with summary/route.ts.
id param not validated against UUID pattern — add UUID guard consistent with summary/route.ts.
id param not validated against UUID pattern — add UUID guard consistent with summary/route.ts.
401 response returned as plain Response (not JSON) — inconsistent with non-SSE admin routes that return NextResponse.json; at minimum return a consistent error body.
Missing eslint and eslint-config-next in devDependencies — next lint will fail without eslint-config-next.
include patterns don't cover .tsx test files — add '**/*.test.tsx' and '**/*.spec.tsx' so future component tests are not silently ignored.

ReactMarkdown imported in both ChatPage (for summary panel) and MessageList.tsx (for message rendering) — two independent markdown instances; extracting the summary panel to a component would consolidate.
Sources fetch uncancelled on unmount — setHasSources called on unmounted component if fetch resolves late; add AbortController matching the SSE effect pattern at line 127.
Two fetch calls in UserAreaProvider run serially and are uncancelled — wrap in Promise.all and add AbortController cleanup.
Scroll-to-bottom effect depends on both messages and isLoading — triggers DOM read when isLoading toggles with no new messages; scope to messages.length.
All lead records fetched from Redis and sorted in-process on every request — O(n) amplification; Redis sorted sets would enable server-side pagination at scale.
sessionModeKey written before checking if session exists — mode key written even when messages is null (session not found); add existence guard before write.
Meta records fetched with Promise.all of individual redis.get calls — replace with a pipeline to reduce round-trips.
All chunks fetched from vector index in one call with no pagination — large sources produce large payloads; add page/limit if this becomes a problem.
Vector score filter uses strict > instead of >= — a score exactly equal to VECTOR_MIN_SCORE (0.4) is silently dropped; clarify intent or change to >= and update constant name.
Admin nav links to sessions[0].id in unsorted array — may not be the most recently active session; sort by lastActiveAt desc before using index 0.
Happy-path response body never asserted — a regression changing { text } to { reply } would pass all tests; add assertion for response body shape.
GEMINI_API_KEY-missing 500 path has zero coverage — vitest.setup.ts always provides the key; add a test that clears the env var for the genAI-null guard branch.
Zero tests for 6 admin session sub-routes: join, leave, message, typing, GET /sessions/[id], GET /sessions — including auth-guarded paths and mode changes.
No tests for /api/session/[id]/end or /api/session/[id]/switch-ai — two session-control routes that write mode to Redis and publish events are completely uncovered.
No tests for /api/admin/leads/clear or /api/admin/sources/clear — clear-all mutations are completely untested.
SESSIONS_ACTIVE_KEY delete not asserted in POST clear test — the production pipeline del(SESSIONS_ACTIVE_KEY) step is not verified.
verifyAdminToken always mocked true — no 401 path tested; auth guard could be removed without any test failure.
Same auth mock problem — no 401 path tested for POST /api/sources or GET /api/sources/[id]/rows.
indexSource, deleteSourceVectors, and queryRelevantChunks not tested — only chunkCsv and chunkVectorId covered; score filtering at VECTOR_MIN_SCORE has zero coverage.
createSubscriber not tested — missing REDIS_URL error throw and happy-path subscriber instantiation are uncovered.
Promise.all mock ordering is fragile — sequential mockResolvedValueOnce values are positional; reordering Promise.all arguments produces wrong test results with no failure.
Same Promise.all ordering assumption — hardcoded [messages, mode] order in mock setup; a comment documents the risk but no guard exists.
ChatPage has no unit or integration tests — sendMessage optimistic update, pendingSession state machine, and SSE reconnect are complex uncovered paths.
session-actions test doesn't verify concurrent execution — asserts calls happened but not that redis.set and redis.get were initiated concurrently via Promise.all.
Non-UUID guestId ('g-0001') used in tests — if UUID validation is added, tests silently return 400 without an obvious explanation; use a real UUID constant.
rowCount only asserted to be typeof 'number' in multi-sheet test — not a concrete value; doesn't verify counting logic.
Invalid date strings untested — error-handling paths of formatRelativeTime and formatDate for invalid input are uncovered.
Login success test doesn't assert SameSite or Path cookie attributes — a regression removing SameSite=Strict would go undetected.
/api/admin/logout not explicitly tested in middleware tests — intentionally works without auth, but no test documents this decision.
No test for switch-ai idempotency or non-existent session — given the missing auth gap (f-043), the security-test gap doubles the risk.
LeadForm validate() is unexported and untested — extracting to the shared data module (f-055) would enable direct testing.
exportCSV, exportJSON, exportExcel untested — manipulate the DOM and have the silent page-limit bug (current-page only); add tests that mock URL.createObjectURL.
react-markdown loaded eagerly in ChatPage solely for the conditionally-rendered summary panel — consider next/dynamic to defer bundle weight if summary is rarely used.

createChannelSSE creates an ioredis subscriber via createSubscriber() but never attaches an .on('error', ...) handler, and sub.subscribe(channel) is not awaited/caught either — a connection error on this client (Redis restart/network blip) can become an unhandled error event / rejection affecting every open SSE stream.
formatRelativeTime parses iso into a Date once as d to validate it, then re-parses the same string with new Date(iso) again on the final return line instead of reusing d.

getDeviceInfo is typed to return Record<string, string> even though it always returns a fixed field set mirroring optional device fields on SessionMeta — typing it against a shared/dedicated DeviceInfo type would let the compiler catch a rename/typo in either place.

When an admin sends a message to a session with no sessionModeKey set yet, the local mode = currentMode ?? 'human' used for the SSE publish payload is never persisted via redis.set(sessionModeKey(id), mode) (unlike join/leave which call setSessionMode) — a subsequent page load reports the session back as 'ai' even though an admin already intervened.
No test exercises 'admin sends message on a session with no prior mode set' followed by a re-fetch of session state, which would catch the mode-persistence gap (f-120).
await req.json() is not wrapped in try/catch, so a malformed JSON body throws an unhandled exception (generic 500) instead of a clean 400 response.

await req.json() is not wrapped in try/catch and username/password are not validated as strings before createHash().update(password), so a malformed/empty request body throws unhandled instead of returning a clean 400.
No coverage exists for the malformed-JSON-body / missing-field login path (f-123) — a regression here would only surface as a raw 500 in production.

The pipeline issues a redundant p.zscore(SESSIONS_ACTIVE_KEY, id) per session even though the score is already retrievable from the initial redis.zrange(..., { rev: true }) call by passing withScores: true.

The lead field allow-list (name, email, phone, country, educationLevel, programOfInterest, intendedIntake) is hand-duplicated between the leadMap.set(...) object literal and the fallback default object, so the two can silently diverge.

page/limit are parsed with parseInt and passed through Math.max/Math.min with no isNaN check, so a non-numeric page/limit query param propagates as NaN, producing an empty paginated slice instead of a 400 or sane default.

Every call fetches and deserializes the entire LEADS_ALL_KEY set via pipeline and sorts/searches/paginates it in memory regardless of the requested page/limit, so response cost grows linearly with total lead count.

The Gemini grounding tool is configured with googleSearchRetrieval + dynamicRetrievalConfig (the Gemini 1.5-era grounding API) while MODELS/DEFAULT_MODEL point at gemini-3.x models, which use a different grounding tool schema — the search-grounding fallback path likely silently fails or errors for these model versions.

No test exercises the branch where useGrounding is true AND relevantChunks.length > 0 (PROMPT_GROUNDING_WITH_CONTEXT for contact queries with local chunks present) — only the 'no chunks' and 'chunks with no grounding' paths are covered, and this is exactly the path affected by the possible schema mismatch in f-129.
The describe block says 'returns 200 with a reply field on success' but the route actually returns a text field (correctly asserted) — the description doesn't match the field it verifies.
queryRelevantChunks(message) is only kicked off after all Redis writes and pubsub publishes complete instead of running concurrently with them, adding avoidable latency to every AI-mode chat turn.
Unlike the sibling end and switch-ai routes, this handler never validates params.id against UUID_RE before using it to build Redis keys.
On Gemini failure the raw String(err) is returned to the client ({ error: String(err) }), leaking internal error detail, unlike app/api/chat/route.ts which sanitizes the equivalent failure message.

When id doesn't match any source, target is undefined and updated equals the original list, yet the handler still writes the unchanged list back to Redis and returns 200 instead of 404, masking a no-op delete.

DELETE /api/sources/[id] — a destructive route that also calls deleteSourceVectors — has no test coverage anywhere under tests/ (tests/api/sources.test.ts only exercises POST), leaving both the destructive path and the not-found/no-op behavior (f-135) unverified.
sheetMap.get(...).rows.push(...dataRows) spreads the full per-chunk row array as call arguments, which can throw a stack-size RangeError once a source's combined row count for a sheet grows large.

filename and csv are destructured from the request body with no type/presence validation before csvStr.startsWith(...)/.split(...) are called, so a malformed or missing csv field throws an unhandled TypeError instead of a clean 400.
GET /api/session/[id] (session messages/mode fetch, with no auth or ownership check) has no dedicated test file anywhere under tests/, unlike the other session subroutes.
The SSE endpoint has no test coverage at all, so regressions in channel wiring or abort/cleanup handling (lib/sse.ts) would go undetected.

The field-update/validate/submit logic and full form markup in LeadForm.tsx (lines 33-263) is near-identical to app/(user-area)/profile/page.tsx (lines 61-226) — a bug fix or field change made in one silently won't apply to the other unless a shared LeadFormFields/useLeadForm component or hook is extracted.
parsePhone and parseIntake are pure functions with real branching (no-space fallback, parts.length < 2 fallback) exercised nowhere, with no coverage verifying the fallback paths.
The summarizing-state spinner SVG is hand-copied inline instead of reusing the existing SpinnerIcon component already used elsewhere in the app.

requestHuman, switchToAI, and endChat all fire POST requests with only .catch(console.error), so a failed request/switch/end leaves the UI silently out of sync with the server with no error shown to the user.

The /api/sources fetch in the one-time setup effect has no AbortController/cleanup unlike the other fetch effects in this file, so a fast unmount before the response resolves calls setState on an unmounted component.
MessageList is not wrapped in React.memo, so every keystroke in the chat input re-renders MessageList and re-parses every message through ReactMarkdown even though its own props haven't changed.
modeBadgeStyle is defined but never referenced anywhere in the file — dead code.

handleAccept navigates to the session page in .finally() regardless of whether the join POST succeeded, only console.error-ing failures, so an admin can land on a session believing they've accepted it when the join actually failed server-side.

fetchSessions has a try/finally with no catch; it's invoked unawaited from a timer and from es.onmessage, so a network failure produces an unhandled promise rejection with no user-visible error state.
The guestGroups grouping/merge logic inside the useMemo (de-dupes sessions by guestId, backfills guest info once a name is found) is real branching pure logic embedded inline and untested.

The EventSource connect/reconnect-with-3s-backoff logic is duplicated almost verbatim across app/admin/layout.tsx, app/admin/sessions/[id]/page.tsx, and app/(user-area)/chat/page.tsx — three independent implementations of the same reconnect pattern with no shared hook (e.g. useEventSource).
fetchLeads has no in-flight/stale-response guard, so if page/sort/order/search change quickly, a slower older response can resolve after a newer one and overwrite the table with stale data.

xlsx is statically imported at module top-level, bundling the whole library into the page even when the user never clicks 'Excel', unlike app/admin/sources/page.tsx which correctly lazy-loads it via await import('xlsx') inside the handler.

exportCSV/exportJSON/exportExcel only export the current leads state (a single paginated page, limit 20) — exporting with total > 20 silently produces an incomplete file with no indication only the visible page was exported.
The CSV row-building/escaping logic inside exportCSV (branching for the submittedAt column and quote-doubling) is un-exported inline logic with real edge cases and no coverage.

sendMessage clears inputText immediately and only wraps the POST in try/finally (no catch), so if the send fails the admin's typed reply is silently lost with no error shown and no way to retry/restore the text.
takeOver and handBack call fetch with zero error handling; a failed request produces no feedback to the admin and relies entirely on the SSE stream to reflect the mode change.
fetchSession has no catch around the fetch/JSON parse and is called unawaited from useEffect, risking an unhandled promise rejection on network failure.

handleClearSessions, handleClearSources, and handleClearLeads, along with their nine backing useState calls, are near-identical copy-pasted logic that could be consolidated into one generic 'clear resource' handler/reducer parameterized by URL and clearedLabel.
handleRemove silently no-ops on a failed DELETE (if (!resp.ok) return;) with no user-facing error, inconsistent with handleFileSelected which properly sets uploadError on failure.

GET /api/admin/leads calls verifyAdminToken and returns 401 when unauthenticated, but this suite mocks verifyAdminToken to always resolve true and never flips it to false, so the auth guard is completely untested here — unlike every sibling admin/*.test.ts file which does test the 401 path.
Only POST is imported and tested; GET /api/sources, which returns the persisted source list, has zero test coverage in this file.

The 'ADMIN_USERNAME missing' test deletes process.env.ADMIN_USERNAME and restores it with no try/finally, so a failing assertion leaves the var deleted and cascades failures into every later test in the file — contrast with tests/api/chat.test.ts and tests/api/session/summary.test.ts which wrap the identical pattern in try/finally.

The verifyAdminToken vi.mock scaffolding and the near-identical redis pipeline mock (get/del/exec + mockReturnThis chaining) is duplicated near-verbatim across 8+ test files with no shared helper module in tests/, making it easy for one copy to drift from the others.
The message route explicitly rejects non-string text, but the suite only tests missing text and over-length text — no test sends a non-string payload (e.g. { text: 123 }) to cover that branch.
indexSource's multi-batch upsert path (BATCH=10) is never exercised with more than 10 chunks, so the parallel-batching/Promise.all behavior is untested.
Windows 8.1 (NT 6.3) and Windows 8 (NT 6.2) entries in the version map are untested even though the sibling 10.0/6.1 entries are covered.
The generic non-iPad tablet branch (/Tablet/.test(ua) && !/Mobile/.test(ua)) is never exercised — only the iPad tablet path is tested.
No boundary tests exist for PHONE_NUM_RE's 6-15 character range (e.g. exactly-6 valid, or 16+ invalid) despite validate() enforcing that exact range.
No test covers a non-4-digit intake year (e.g. '202' or '20255'), which validate() rejects via a distinct /^\d{4}$/ check separate from the year-range bounds that are already tested.

'returns an ioredis instance when REDIS_URL is set' only asserts the result is defined; combined with the bare-class ioredis mock that discards its constructor argument, nothing actually verifies createSubscriber passes REDIS_URL through to the Redis constructor.
The makeReq() NextRequest/admin_token-cookie builder is duplicated near-verbatim in tests/middleware.test.ts and could be extracted into a shared test helper.

The mocked sessionModeKey/sessionMessagesKey builders (and similarly adminSessionKey in tests/lib/admin-auth.test.ts) hand-duplicate the exact key-format strings from lib/redis.ts, so a real key-format change there could silently drift from what these tests assume rather than failing loudly.
No test covers a future timestamp (negative diff), which formatRelativeTime silently coerces to 'Just now' via mins < 1 — this behavior is unverified.
buildHeader()'s two-row header merging (parent label + sub-label combined into 'Label: sub') is never exercised by any test, despite being a distinct documented feature of the header-detection logic.

The script's local chunkCsv() prepends a 'File: {filename}' line to every chunk, but the actual chunkCsv() in lib/vector.ts (used by app/api/sources/route.ts for UI uploads) never includes the filename in chunk text — sources reindexed via this script produce different embedded/stored chunk text than sources uploaded through the admin UI, causing inconsistent RAG behavior depending on how a source was indexed.

redisGet() does not check res.ok before reading json.result (unlike redisSet, vectorDelete, and vectorUpsertData, which all throw on a non-ok response), so a failed/unauthorized Redis REST call silently falls through to null and the script proceeds as if there were no existing sources.

The coverage block has no all: true (and no explicit coverage.include), so v8 coverage only reports on files actually imported during test runs rather than the full source tree — untested files are omitted entirely rather than counted as 0%, inflating the reported coverage percentage.
@google/generative-ai is pinned to ^0.21.0 while a later 0.2x release (0.24.1) is available and reachable within the existing caret range — bump to pick up subsequent fixes.
